newsitem.title: INDIA: India's 96/97 cement output up at 70 mln t-CMA.
newsitem.headline: India's 96/97 cement output up at 70 mln t-CMA.

text.p: India's cement output in March 1997 was 7.2 million tonnes compared to 6.5 million tonnes in March 1996, a spokesman of the Cement Manufacturers Association (CMA) said on Wednesday.
He said cement production and deliveries during 1996/97 (April-March) amounted to 70.0 million tonnes compared with 64.5 million tonnes during 1995/96.
"Dispatches in March were 7.15 million tonnes against 6.5 million tonnes (year-ago period) showing almost 10 percent growth," the CMA spokesman told Reuters.
The figures show the industry fared better than many expected despite a slowdown in the economy and numerous problems during the year, he said.
